communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records regarding this agency acquisition and use of BriefCam, video analytics software sold by Milestone Systems (https://www.milestonesys.com/products/briefcam/). 

1. All contracts and other agreements between this agency and Milestone Systems/BriefCam, including all amendments and exhibits. This includes any training for Briefcam conducted by Motorola Solutions. 
2. All manuals, handbooks, policies, and other directives on the use of the BriefCam system. This includes all information on how to use the system itself and all materials on the appropriate use of this system by employees of this agency.This includes any training for Briefcam conducted by Motorola Solutions. 
3. All user audit and access logs reflecting access of or actions taken within the BriefCam system. Please provide these materials for the period from when the system was first made functional through the date on which this request is processed. Please provide these logs as a .csv or .xls file, if possible. 
4. A copy of the metadata associated with all alerts generated by this agency’s BriefCam system for the period from January 1, 2025 through the date on which this request is processed. This metadata should include all available information, including username, event, time stamp, a session ID, the associated IP address, and a description of the activity. Please provide this metadata as a .csv or .xls file, if possible. 

This request is being made by a journalistic researcher. It is being made for research purposes, not commercial ones. Please assess fees in accordance with provisions for media requesters. In the event that this agency decides to charge this requester fees not to exceed the actual cost of reproducing the records, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request.

Please fulfill this request electronically, preferably by e-mail attachment, if available.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response within the statutorily-mandated timeframe. 

Sincerely, 

Dave Maass

title: Department of War support for 2025 Mr. Beast YouTube video "$1 vs $1,000,000,000 Nuclear Bunker"

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

All documents pertaining to collaboration between the US Department of Defense/Department of War (DoW) and the production of the second season of the YouTube video "$1 vs $1,000,000,000 Nuclear Bunker," created by Mr. Beast. According to a document released to me by DoW through FOIA (attached to this request), DoW provided support to this production. I therefore request any and all documents pertaining to DoW support for "$1 vs $1,000,000,000 Nuclear Bunker." Such documents may include but should not be not limited to: script notes; production assistance agreements; photographs; and all records of communications between employees of DoW and members of the cast, crew, and production company of "$1 vs $1,000,000,000 Nuclear Bunker," including memos, notes of meetings and conference calls, emails, and other forms of communication.

I am the Director of Research Operations at a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization called The Decoding Culture Foundation. These documents will be used for public education and research purposes. I therefore request a waiver of all fees that may otherwise apply. Attached is a document with organization letterhead confirming my position, as well as the organization's 501(c)(3) application and approval form.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Brett Carollo
